title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
  • Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
  • Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
  • Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
  • Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
  • Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
  • Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
  • Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
  • Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.

Our compensation package:

  • Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
  • Profit Sharing.
  • Health and Dental insurance.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Gympass / Totalpass.

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on‑boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on‑boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

title: Executive Assistant BRA (Remote)
description:
An Executive Assistant (EA) provides high-level administrative support to executives, senior leaders, or company founders, ensuring their schedules, communications, and daily operations run smoothly . This role acts as a strategic partner, enabling executives to focus on decision-making and leadership responsibilities while the EA manages essential organizational and logistical tasks behind the scenes.

Typical responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars with multiple time zones, organizing and prioritizing meetings, preparing agendas, and ensuring executives are fully briefed ahead of engagements. Executive Assistants also arrange travel itineraries —including flights, accommodations, and transportation—while anticipating potential issues and providing contingency plans.

Beyond scheduling, EAs are often responsible for drafting and editing correspondence , preparing high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing documents , and managing internal and external communications on behalf of the executive. Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion is critical, as is maintaining a professional demeanor when liaising with board members, clients, and other stakeholders.

An effective EA also monitors project timelines , follows up on action items, and acts as a gatekeeper—managing requests for the executive’s time and attention while balancing competing priorities. They often identify opportunities to streamline processes, implement productivity tools , and enhance the efficiency of the executive office.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills , keen attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced and high-pressure environments, and excellent communication abilities. The most effective Executive Assistants combine administrative expertise with strategic thinking, becoming an indispensable partner in the achievement of organizational goals.

A Social Media Manager is responsible for building, managing, and expanding a company’s presence across multiple social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, and emerging channels. Daily responsibilities often include planning editorial calendars , creating engaging text, image, and video content, scheduling and publishing posts, and actively interacting with followers to foster an engaged online community. A Social Media Manager also monitors industry trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity to adapt strategies proactively.

Equally important is performance analysis —tracking metrics such as reach, engagement, click-through rates, and conversions to assess campaign effectiveness and inform future decisions. This requires proficiency with analytics tools, an understanding of paid advertising, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable improvements.

Success in this position demands strong communication skills, creativity, adaptability, and a deep understanding of digital marketing principles . A great Social Media Manager not only amplifies brand awareness but also drives audience loyalty and contributes directly to achieving broader business goals.

A Wilson Sons Ultratug Offshore é uma joint venture entre a Wilson Sons e a Ultramar. A Wilson Sons é um dos maiores operadores integrados de serviços marítimos, portuários e de logística do Brasil, com mais 180 anos de experiência. Com 23 embarcações, a Wilson Sons Offshore oferece apoio marítimo a plataformas de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás. Trata-se do segmento mais jovem da Wilson Sons: suas atividades foram iniciadas em 2003. Hoje já contamos com uma das maiores e mais modernas frotas em apoio Offshore com bandeira brasileira.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions, and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students. This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including registration permissions, overrides, waitlist, and batch registration.
  • Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
  • Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
  • Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
  • Produces academic standing and Dean’s list reports for review by the Provost’s Office and various schools and colleges.
  • Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
  • Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
  • Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
  • Develops and delivers point‑of‑use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
  • Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account.

Core Competencies

  • Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e., Banner, Colleague, Workday).
  • Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
  • Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
  • Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
  • Detail‑oriented and customer service and compliance‑focused.
  • Proven record of accountability and follow‑through.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar’s office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.

Expected Salary Range

$65,000 - $75,000

Responsibilities

  • Acolhimento e Educação do Paciente
  • Realiza o acolhimento inicial após o diagnóstico oncológico, explicando a doença, o plano terapêutico e os próximos passos.

  • Garante que o paciente compreenda seus direitos, canais de apoio e como acessar os serviços disponíveis.

  • Atua como ponto focal do paciente ao longo de todo o tratamento: diagnóstico, estadiamento, tratamento ativo e seguimento.

  • Assegura o cumprimento de critérios de segurança: identificação correta do paciente, checagem de prescrição, orientação pré e pós-infusão.
  • Monitora e registra reações adversas imediatas e tardias, com notificação ao time médico e farmacêutico.

  • Atua em conjunto com a farmácia clínica para garantir a dispensação segura de medicamentos oncológicos orais.
  • Confirma elegibilidade e autorização prévia dos protocolos, orientando o paciente quanto à posologia, armazenamento e sinais de toxicidade.

  • Participa do monitoramento longitudinal de desfechos assistenciais, como resposta ao tratamento, hospitalizações evitáveis e efeitos adversos.
  • Apoia o time de auditoria e autorização técnica com visão clínica e conhecimento do histórico do paciente.

  • Apoio Psicossocial e Humanização
  • Identifica sinais de sofrimento emocional, barreiras sociais e insegurança quanto ao tratamento.
  • Articula com a equipe multiprofissional (psicologia, nutrição, assistência social) e promove um cuidado centrado na pessoa.
  • Garante o vínculo contínuo com o paciente e seus familiares, reduzindo abandono e interrupções não planejadas.

title: Completion Engineer (Lower Completion Specialist)
description:
Overview

Focusing on lower completions, this position will plan, design, and execute lower completion and gravel pack operations, provide offshore technical supervision, coordinate with wells, subsurface, and operations teams, and ensure proper well closeout and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by Subsurface team
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly Budgets and well/project specific AFE's
  • Forecast and accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific Long Lead requirements
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination & quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required including conducting service quality meetings
  • Ensure Vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the Company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process so as to ensure timely action/close out
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required
  • Contributor to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS)
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, and execution and closeout activities
  • Ensure compliance with Company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied materials, equipment and services which includes review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and 3rd party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Design Reservoir Lower Completion for producer and injector wells across different assets within the company
  • Perform Torque & Drag analysis for deploying lower completions in long horizontal wells. Specify landing string and evaluate the requirement for swiveling devices
  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team which includes lower completion sizing and design, GP pumping schedule, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities
  • Establish well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material & equipment selection
  • Identify special Engineering Studies to be performed
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and capable of presenting a succinct recommendation
  • Raise Requisitions & Purchase Orders
  • Ensure compliance of Vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services which includes but is not limited to review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation
  • Review all applicable operating, installing & testing procedures, including interface documents
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP as part of well/project commencement
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices
  • Review the engineering focussed After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt
  • Responsible for compilation of End of well Reports (EOWRs)

Education

  • Degree qualification in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage

Experience

  • Experience in Lower Completion and GP Pumping engineering
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution
  • Experience with Alternate Path GP pumping technology is considered an advantage
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages
  • Knowledge of GP pumping software PackPro or similar

  • Atualizar cadastros técnicos em sistemas como o SAP.

description:
Volunteer System Manager

Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). The Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model. This role leads the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform while overseeing essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT, and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset.
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification desired.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Familiaridade com o universo esportivo, entender o jogo importa. Modalidade específica pode variar, mas repertório é essencial.
  • Vivência com rotinas de publicação, cobertura em tempo real e adaptação rápida a mudanças de contexto.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de alta demanda e múltiplos projetos.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com senso de responsabilidade e execução consistente.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em grupos de mídia, projetos esportivos, plataformas digitais ou streaming.
  • Conhecimento em vídeo para redes sociais, edição básica ou direção de conteúdo audiovisual.
  • Vivência com planejamento de cobertura esportiva, cronogramas editoriais e storytelling multiplataforma.
  • Interesse ou uso prático de IA e novas tecnologias aplicadas à produção de conteúdo.
  • Ideias, projetos autorais ou experimentações que demonstrem inquietação criativa e vontade de fazer diferente.

Nossos benefícios

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte, e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO . Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A Empodera –Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma organização, sem fins lucrativos, com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional. Fundada em 2017, desenvolve programas e projetos esportivos, com viés educacional, para meninas adolescentes e mulheres periféricas, e capacita organizações de todo o Brasil na criação de espaços seguros para meninas no esporte. A Empodera é uma organização especializada em gênero e esporte e trabalha em prol do empoderamento de meninas e mulheres, em sua pluralidade, utilizando as práticas corporais e esportivas como ferramentas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades socioemocionais e a discussão de temas-chave para que as atendidas desenvolvam seu pleno potencial e exerçam os seus direitos.

description:

Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO CTI NEONATAL - DIARISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Promover, juntamente ao Gestor imediato, um ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial, realizando interface com as demais áreas, a fim de garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos estipulados pela Instituição e o bom atendimento ao usuário.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem
Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Urgência/Emergência (Pronto Socorro), Saúde Pública, Gestão em Saúde ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função Enfermeiro.
Informações adicionais
Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
Escala de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta-feira (30h)
Horário de trabalho: 08:00 às 14:00h

title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais - Ipanema/RJ
description:
Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais - Ipanema/RJ

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizado progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

Esta posição é para Os Batutinhas, uma das marcas de escola do Inspired no Brasil. Somos uma escola com mais de 20 anos de história formando as nossas crianças para saírem preparadas para enfrentar os desafios do Ensino Fundamental, apaixonados por literatura e com prazer de investigar o mundo. Baseado na teoria construtivista, o trabalho d’Os Batutinhas é ancorado na visão de que a criança assume o lugar de protagonista no seu processo de aprendizagem, construindo conhecimentos sobre o mundo e sobre si mesma.

Nossa missão é contribuir para a formação de crianças criativas, éticas e conscientes de seus deveres por meio da ampliação do repertório cultural e da formação contínua da equipe. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Neste papel você será responsável pela limpeza e organização dos espaços da escola.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Realizar a limpeza e organização dos espaços da escola (pisos, paredes, tetos, sanitários, pias, vidraças, jardins, pátios);
  • Retirar o lixo da unidade;
  • Realizar o transporte de móveis e objetos em geral.

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino Fundamental completo;
  • Experiência prévia na função.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Treinamentos voltados para a posição de Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais;
  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Experiência prévia em escola.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

title: Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"). This event, hosted in South America in Brazil, presents an opportunity to be part of creating a unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

Key responsibilities

Accreditation Documentation & Content Management

  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.

Training Material Development & Delivery

  • Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.

Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination

  • Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

Your Profile

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Technology Contract Manager

Department: Technology

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Technology Operations, the Technology Contract Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team, and work in close collaboration with the Technology teams based in Brazil and other key individuals responsible for overseeing the relationship, performance, and contract management of our strategic technology partners and suppliers. Drawing on your experience as part of significant sporting event, you will contribute to the success of this global spectacle.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overseeing a diverse portfolio of technology contracts, ensuring adherence to contractual obligations and performance standards.
  • Developing and implementing a robust contract management strategy to streamline processes and enhance overall efficiency.
  • Support the management of relationships across a large base of technology vendors and suppliers to foster collaboration and address any issues promptly.
  • Leading negotiations for contract renewals, amendments, and extensions to ensure favourable terms and cost-effectiveness.
  • Develop and create contracts, NDAs, and SoWs using established templates.
  • Proactively foster and nurture robust relationships within an ecosystem of partners and vendors, leveraging your experience from to benefit tournament in achieving its goals.
  • Manage the governance and controls framework, in collaboration with project leads / SMEs.
  • Proactively manage risks and issues within technology and change related to contract and performance management.
  • Apply expertise in reporting financial spend (using tools such as Power BI, SAP, etc.) related to contracts, invoices etc.
  • Lead and oversee tender processes, including initiating and executing technology purchase requisitions via SAP in accordance with procurement guidelines.
  • Coordinate multi-supplier/partner collaborations and contribute to decisions on supplier proposals to continually enhance services, including the development of an evaluation process.
  • Document management of all tender documents, contracts, and invoices in accordance with the storage management requirements.
  • Responsible for ensuring the execution of contracts follow the appropriate workflows via DocuSign.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree or equivalent high education.

Qualification

  • Proven track record in managing and implementing Governance Processes.
  • Extensive experience in running KPI/SLA driven engagement.
  • Significant commercial and contract management experience.
  • Proven track record in leading procurements.
  • Strong understanding of suppliers and contract management.
  • Industry knowledge and experience or understanding of the structure and organization of utilities and their core activities.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall technology contract management experience and minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role
  • Experience in the sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of managing complex and high spend technology contracts across tier one telecoms and network providers

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent teamwork and leadership skills
  • Excellent written, verbal, and active listening communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills
  • Conflict resolution skills are a must.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Proven ability to manage teams remotely.
  • Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High sense of accountability, trustworthiness, and ethics.
  • Customer and results oriented.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portuguese
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools

title: Curriculum & Assessment Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Curriculum and Assessment manager will oversee and assist with data management, organization, and analysis for continuous quality improvement initiatives, student performance for annual assessment reporting, and external accreditation. The manager must be well‑versed in assessment measures, methodologies, and data analysis. The position will provide data management, data reporting and support to the Office of Academic Affairs staff in fulfilling the accreditation and evaluation functions of the dental school curriculum.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students, and staff within The College of Dentistry and University. External contacts include government agencies, corporations, foundations, vendors, other colleges and universities, visitors and the public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Support monitoring student progress, curriculum review, program self‑study, accreditation preparation, and continuous quality improvement functions.
  • Collect and analyze data/artifacts for direct and indirect assessment measures, including surveys, course, faculty and student data.
  • Assist with annual university assessment reporting including updating the Colleges assessment plan complete with what was done and the supporting documentation.
  • Ensure that there is an ongoing schedule for assessing areas in the College as identified by the Academic Dean.
  • Assist with self‑study coordination and reporting and accreditation site visit preparation, including coordinating, organizing, and formatting programmatic reports for reporting to identified entities.
  • Lead course evaluation process and data analysis.
  • Ensure the reliability and validity of assessment and survey instruments and recommend changes and enhancement as necessary.
  • Assist with the execution of a plan to cultivate a culture of assessment within the College of Dentistry based on data.
  • Harness assessment data to identify opportunities to improve program performance and achieve goals.
  • Coordinate curricular optimization with faculty and instructional design staff, completing the assessment “feedback loop.”
  • Produce ad‑hoc analyses, reports, graphs, and data as needed for both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design, distribute and maintain the electronic teaching evaluations.
  • Troubleshoot ExamSoft issues and assist faculty and students with ExamSoft challenges.
  • Assist in developing statistical models to measure impact of learning support services on student achievement of intended learning outcomes.
  • Develop item analysis reports as necessary to help faculty evaluate the effectiveness of tests and test items.
  • Help conduct focus groups with students and/or faculty and staff to get insight into practices that work and those that do not.
  • Stay abreast of current academic trends and policies regarding curricular and programmatic assessment and implementing effective assessment techniques at the college.
  • Participate as an ex‑officio member of identified committees.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Project management tools such as SharePoint.
  • Intermediate‑advanced data visualization.
  • Familiarity with importing/exporting from various databases and/or systems.
  • Familiarity with online survey management tools.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training to an audience with varying levels of technical understanding.
  • Experience supporting faculty in a teaching/learning environment.
  • Previous data analytics and database management experience.
  • Ability to manipulate data within and across MS Office products (e.g., conduct Microsoft Word email merges using mail lists in Excel, import data from Excel into Access).
  • Experience with LMS (ex. CANVAS) and assessment tools (ex. ExamSoft) would be preferred.
  • Ability to establish and maintain productive and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, and the public.
  • Must have exceptional oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong team‑oriented, analytical, problem‑solving and decision‑making skills.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferably in education administration, data science, education, health care administration or public health preferred and 3 years of related experience.

Expected Pay Range: $63,363 - $70,000

Descrição da vaga

O Mecânico de Manutenção de Equipamentos Pesados será um profissional chave na equipe, responsável por assegurar a plena operacionalidade e segurança de uma vasta gama de máquinas. Este profissional irá realizar diagnósticos e reparos em sistemas elétricos, de refrigeração e mecânica hidráulica, atuando na manutenção preventiva e corretiva de Guindastes LIEBHERR e FUWA, Empilhadeiras HYUNDAI e HYSTER, e equipamentos da Linha Amarela, incluindo máquinas Volvo e Caterpillar. Será essencial a leitura e interpretação de diagramas para identificação e resolução de falhas, assim como a substituição precisa de peças e componentes. O(a) Mecânico(a) deverá assegurar a conformidade das manutenções com as normas de segurança (como NBR 15965), gerenciar e priorizar tarefas sob prazos, lidar dinamicamente com múltiplas demandas, aplicar senso crítico e de urgência na resolução de problemas, e manter atenção rigorosa aos detalhes em todas as etapas, além de preencher relatórios de serviço e registros de manutenção de forma precisa e organizada.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e defeitos mecânicos em sistemas diversos.
  • Fazer ajustes e regulagens em componentes mecânicos.
  • Monitorar o funcionamento de máquinas, identificando a necessidade de reparos.
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre as atividades de manutenção realizadas.
  • Colaborar na montagem e desmonte de equipamentos, conforme necessário.
  • Cumprir normas de segurança e procedimentos operacionais estabelecidos.
  • Acompanhar a manutenção de registros e documentação técnica.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Amplo conhecimento em elétrica para manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas de refrigeração.
  • Conhecimento Mecânico Hidráulico.
  • Leitura de Diagrama e identificação de falhas.
  • Conhecimento em Empilhadeiras e Guindastes (incluindo modelos LIEBHERR, FUWA, HYUNDAI, HYSTER).
  • Conhecimento e experiência em manutenção de equipamentos da Linha Amarela (Volvo e Caterpillar).
  • Conhecimento da norma NBR 15965 (se relevante para o escopo da empresa).

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica | HapVida.
  • Convênio Farmácia.
  • Alimentação no local.
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras.

Sobre a empresa

A Triunfo Logística oferece soluções competitivas de operação portuária e logística de acordo com os mais elevados padrões de qualidade e segurança, respeito ao indivíduo e ao meio ambiente, agregando máximo valor aos acionistas e à sociedade de forma ética e inovadora. Trabalhamos focados em ser reconhecida como uma referência nacional na área portuária e marítima, promovendo a logística integrada de forma efetiva e reafirmando a nossa crescente vocação criativa, tornando-nos a maior operadora multi-purpose do Brasil. Ética, respeito e transparência, é assim que definimos nosso trabalho e negócio;

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are also a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The role of a Treasury Analyst at Canonical

As a Treasury Analyst, you will be a key team member of the Finance team ensuring that Canonical's global liquidity and cash movements are managed and controlled in a manner consistent with our Treasury Policy. You will support the execution of approved cash management including international intercompany funding, multi-currency transactions and FX strategies while managing the financial risks associated with global operations.

You will partner closely with Group Accounting, FP&A and other stakeholders to monitor forecasted cash needs, funding requirements and operational drivers. You will also contribute to treasury reporting and analysis for senior leadership, supporting decision‑making with clear insights and recommendations.

Location

This is a globally remote role.

What your day will look like

  • Maintain controls over group cash, banking and investment activities, ensuring strong governance and policy compliance
  • Execute and track treasury operations (e.g., funding movements, payments, account activity)
  • Monitor liquidity and working capital needs, helping optimise cash utilisation while maintaining required buffers
  • Support the company's FX risk strategy by monitoring exposures and executing approved FX activity
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for banking counterparties, overseeing the company's banking set‑up, account governance and ongoing relationship management
  • Produce regular treasury reporting and ad‑hoc analysis for senior management, highlighting key movements, risks, and recommendations
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of Treasury Policy, controls, and operational processes
  • Develop and maintain detailed rolling cash flow forecasts at subsidiary and consolidated levels to optimise liquidity
  • Formulate and execute approved investment strategies for surplus cash, balancing security, liquidity and yield in line with Canonical's Treasury Policy

What we are looking for in you

  • Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character
  • Experience in managing funds in 20+ currencies, across multiple corporate entities
  • CTP, CFA, or equivalent certification in Treasury or Analysis
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets and financial modeling
  • Experience with enterprise level financial management software, such as NetSuite.
  • Exceptional financial and mathematical abilities
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • MBA or equivalent combination of professional experience and certifications
  • Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM, and ERP systems

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person – we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st‑century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
A área de Dados e Inteligência Artificial (Dados e IA) da Vibra Energia é responsável por construir, operar e evoluir as capacidades corporativas de dados e inteligência, garantindo que dados sejam confiáveis, acessíveis, governados e convertidos em decisões e automações de alto impacto para o negócio. A atuação é end-to-end, cobrindo:

  • Ingestão e integração de dados a partir de sistemas internos e fontes externas;
  • Armazenamento e processamento em nuvem, com camadas de data lake/warehouse e serving analítico;

  • Ciência de dados, machine learning e IA, do experimento à produção;
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos de dados e produtos de IA incluindo automações inteligentes e agentes de IA;
  • Plataforma GCP e padrões cloud-native: BigQuery (camada central analítica), Cloud Storage (data lake), Pipelines/orquestração (Cloud Composer, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Workflows), Transformação/modelagem (Dataform, padrões ELT/ETL), Governança/metadata (Dataplex, Data Catalog), BI/consumo (Tableau, Power BI ou Looker), IA/ML (Vertex AI, MLOps/monitoramento), observabilidade e segurança (Cloud Logging/Monitoring, auditoria, LGPD e eficiência de custos – FinOps);
  • Desenvolver soluções de ciência de dados e machine learning para resolver problemas de negócio, atuando do entendimento do problema à entrega de modelos/insights, utilizando Python, BigQuery e Vertex AI (quando aplicável), colaborando com engenharia para operacionalização e com áreas de negócio para capturar valor, incluindo casos que habilitam IA e agentes de IA.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Traduzir problemas de negócio em hipóteses, métricas e experimentos analíticos;
  • Realizar EDA avançada, engenharia de atributos (feature engineering) e preparação de datasets de treinamento;
  • Treinar e avaliar modelos (classificação, regressão, séries temporais, clustering, recomendação conforme demanda);
  • Implementar pipelines de treino/inferência (ex.: notebooks + pipelines em Vertex AI, quando aplicável);
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados em BigQuery e otimizar extrações para modelagem;
  • Apoiar deploy inicial e handoff para produção com engenharia/MLOps (endpoints, batch scoring, jobs agendados);
  • Documentar experimentos (métricas, versão de dados/modelo, decisões) e apoiar monitoramento (drift/performance, quando aplicável);
  • Contribuir para componentes de agentes de IA (ex.: features, scoring, regras inteligentes, avaliação de performance do agente).

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos

  • Python intermediário/avançado (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn; notebooks);
  • Estatística aplicada e fundamentos de ML (validação, overfitting, métricas);
  • SQL avançado e experiência com BigQuery;
  • Familiaridade com GCP e ML (desejável: Vertex AI, pipelines, endpoints);
  • Versionamento com Git e boas práticas de reprodutibilidade;
  • Diferenciais: MLflow/experiment tracking, model registry, LLM/GenAI (quando aplicável), fundamentos de MLOps.

Competências Técnicas

  • Modelagem estatística e ML; validação e métricas;
  • Feature engineering e preparação robusta de dados;
  • Leitura crítica de resultados e interpretação para negócio;
  • Boas práticas de reprodutibilidade (versionamento, documentação).

Competências Comportamentais

  • Pensamento crítico e rigor analítico;
  • Proatividade e curiosidade científica;
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Colaboração com engenharia/produto/negócio.

description:
Join to apply for the Insurance Manager role at FIFA Women's World Cup

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, working alongside FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Application Deadline: 2 June 2025

Department: Finance

Location: Brazil

The Position

The overall purpose of the Insurance Manager is to ensure the efficient implementation and supervision of insurance coverage according to FIFA requirements. The Insurance Manager will also serve as the local contact for Insurance Brokers.

All tasks should be conducted in close collaboration with the FIFA Insurance Lead, and where needed, with the FIFA Audit, Risk & Advisory subdivision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement and monitor appropriate local insurance solutions (Personal, Property Damage, Business Interruption, Marine Cargo & Liability insurances) for all FWWC 2027 entities.
  • Advise and monitor insurance requirements for Host Cities, Stadium Owners, and Training Site Owners, ensuring timely implementation.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Procurement teams to ensure all contracts with sponsors, suppliers, and contractors include adequate insurance clauses, indemnities, and warranties.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor an insurance manual and claim administration policies for stakeholders.
  • Manage claims (Personal, Property, Liability), recording, administering, and reporting them, and coordinating with the FIFA Lead Insurance, brokers, and insurers.
  • Serve as the insurance interface for all internal and external stakeholders of FWWC 2027.
  • Identify and evaluate potential risks, proposing countermeasures.
  • Support the implementation of a local risk management program.
  • Organize regular insurance surveys.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in insurance and risk management.
  • Solid experience with the Brazilian insurance market and risk management, including contract drafting.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian insurance laws and standard practices.
  • Familiarity with local market players and negotiation experience.
  • Proven track record in risk management and insurance issue resolution, including understanding of deductible settings.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Spanish and/or German skills are a plus.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project).
  • Experience with planning software and online collaboration tools is a plus.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. THE POSITION

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Data QA is an important function within Zyte. The Data QA team works to ensure that the quality and usability of the data scraped by our web scrapers meets and exceeds the expectations of our enterprise clients.

Are you passionate about data and data quality and integrity? Do you enjoy using Python and AI to analyze and manipulate data, detect data quality issues, and visualize your findings? Are you highly customer-focused with excellent attention to detail?

  • Strong ML fundamentals: anomaly detection, classification, clustering, embeddings, evaluation metrics
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Spark, BigQuery, or similar)
  • Ability to work with very large datasets (millions+ of records)
  • Version control skills (GitHub/Bitbucket)
  • Excellent communication in English, both technical and non-technical

Desired Skills

  • Prior experience in data quality automation or web data QA
  • Familiarity with LangChain, MCP, Marvin, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Experience building QA dashboards or visualization layers
  • Background in statistics or applied mathematics
  • Previous remote/distributed work experience

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Atuar como ponto focal de relacionamento com Instituições de Ensino (IES), fortalecendo a presença da marca Pravaler no ambiente acadêmico por meio de ações de trade marketing, parcerias estratégicas e iniciativas de captação.

  • Garantir a presença física e digital do Pravaler nas IES.

Aqui no Pravaler , compartilhamos o mesmo propósito de transformar a vida de milhares de brasileiros por meio do acesso à educação. A área de Dados e Inteligência Artificial (Dados e IA) da Vibra Energia é responsável por construir, operar e evoluir as capacidades corporativas de dados e inteligência, garantindo que dados sejam confiáveis, acessíveis, governados e convertidos em decisões e automações de alto impacto para o negócio. A atuação é end-to-end, cobrindo:

  • Ingestão e integração de dados a partir de sistemas internos e fontes externas;

  • BigQuery (camada central analítica);
  • Cloud Storage (data lake);
  • Pipelines/orquestração: Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Workflows;
  • Transformação/modelagem: Dataform, padrões ELT/ETL ;
  • Governança/metadata: Dataplex, Data Catalog;

Overview

Pricing and Deal Desk Senior Analyst at VTEX — Join to apply for the role. VTEX is a global leader in digital commerce technology, providing innovative solutions for businesses seeking excellence in their online ventures. As part of the Pricing & Deal Desk team, you will help optimize pricing models and play a crucial role in strategic negotiations. You will provide essential support globally to various departments and teams, combining organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills to ensure smooth daily tasks and projects.

Responsibilities

  • Analytical and systemic thinking.
  • Interest and ease to learn new tools and concepts.
  • Strong organization and self-motivation.
  • Willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • At least 3 years of experience in the field.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers efficiency and reduces maintenance for organizations modernizing their tech stack. We empower brands, distributors, and retailers with flexibility and comprehensive solutions to invest in what provides a clear business advantage and profitability. VTEX serves 2,600 global B2C and B2B clients with 3,500 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended December 31, 2023). Descrição Detalhada:

  2. Assegurar a manutenção da operacionalidade da frota de embarcações, por meio da participação nos processos de planejamento, decisão e interface com o cliente e interação com os departamentos de suporte quando necessário (suprimentos, manutenção, engenharia, QSMS e RH marítimo);
  3. Aumentar a eficiência, rentabilidade e segurança da operação da frota de embarcações, por meio do acompanhamento dos indicadores de desempenho, da realização de análises críticas e indicação e desenvolvimento de projetos de melhorias para os processos, através do estreito relacionamento com o departamento de QSMS a fim de garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de segurança e procedimentos internos da companhia, assim como atuação no processo de investigação de acidentes;
  4. Garantir atendimento e satisfação dos clientes, por meio de um bom relacionamento, conhecimento dos requisitos estabelecidos, acompanhamento dos índices de avaliação de desempenho, realização de análises críticas desses resultados e indicação de melhorias para os processos, assim como estar atento a tendência e projetos de melhoria para maior satisfação ao cliente;
  5. Assegurar o cumprimento do orçamento de custos e receitas da gerência de operações, por meio da participação nos processos de orçamento, análise crítica dos resultados e indicação de ações preventivas e corretivas, assim como emissão de relatórios de medição do serviço e reembolso, acompanhamento do processo até o pagamento junto com o setor financeiro;
  6. Preservar a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e parceiros, bem como a preservação ambiental, no desenvolvimento das operações, por meio da participação nos processos de análise de riscos, definição de medidas de controle, elaboração de procedimentos e fornecimento de orientações;

Você irá desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento e de melhoria contínua do retorno sobre investimento das ações de captação de recursos de MSF-Brasil, maximizando a contribuição para os projetos médico-humanitários da organização pelo mundo.
