Além disso, deverá desenvolver e incentivar estratégias ousadas, inovadoras, orientadas por dados e que reforcem a marca de MSF, fomentando uma relação com pessoas doadoras pautadas pela ética e transparência, visando sempre a segurança e privacidade de dados. Atuando em estreita colaboração com outras lideranças, garantindo uma abordagem alinhada com a estratégia de MSF-Brasil como um todo e assegurando que o crescimento seja conduzido de forma ética, inclusiva e responsável, considerando a diversidade de públicos, contextos e impactos das estratégias adotadas.

Quais serão seus desafios?

  • Ampliar a base de pessoas doadoras ativas de MSF-Brasil, buscando caminhos inovadores para enfrentar os diferentes desafios no mercado e considerando cada etapa do funil de crescimento;

  • Promover cultura de captação de recursos na organização, equilibrando crescimento, inovação e performance com decisões éticas, inclusivas e alinhadas aos valores institucionais.

Como é o dia a dia da posição?

  • Zelar pela qualidade das entregas da célula, junto aos responsáveis das áreas, garantindo o atendimento às demandas com qualidade;
  • Assegurar que os processos de compras, pagamentos e reports são cumpridos pela célula de acordo com os prazos definidos;

  • Garantir experimentação e implementação de novos canais e abordagens para expandir alcance e performance junto às lideranças da célula e em colaboração estreita com o time de Business Intelligence (BI);
  • Garantir otimização constante da experiência de pessoas usuárias, Régua de Relacionamento e atendimento a pessoas doadoras, zelando pela qualidade de cada contato e considerando abordagem inovadora e omnichannel;

  • Trabalhar com líderes na célula para melhorar processos e fluxos junto às outras células no hub de Engajamento Estratégico em busca de melhor eficiência e agilidade nas atividades;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Filantropia no planejamento e implementação de estratégias para desenvolver pessoas doadoras, tanto pessoas físicas quanto jurídicas, visando aumentar suas contribuições e direcioná-los à categoria de grandes doações, com atendimento personalizado pela equipe de Filantropia;
  • Garantir potencial de otimização da área de sistemas junto a Gerência de Sistemas e GTT através de investimentos em novas tecnologias;
  • Garantir que a célula de crescimento contribua e segue processos de certificação de PCI compliance de MSF e segurança de dados conforme LGPD e políticas de MSF;
  • Negociar as melhores condições de parceria de fornecedores de MSF-Brasil junto as lideranças na célula;
  • Contribuir para projetos de alto nível do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico, conforme necessário;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a estratégia do funil de crescimento de MSF-Brasil, envolvendo as áreas interessadas e garantindo participação ativa de suas equipes na construção;
  • Definir, sustentar e responsabilizar-se pela incorporação de princípios de diversidade, equidade e inclusão nas estratégias, decisões, prioridades e práticas da célula de crescimento, influenciando lideranças, equipes e parceiros e promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e coerente com os valores de MSF;
  • Garantir participação e acompanhamento de plataformas internacionais relevantes para MSF-Brasil, trazendo ideias inovadoras e adaptando para o cenário brasileiro;

Promoção de cultura de Captação de Recursos

  • Ser responsável pela construção de uma cultura de captação de recursos em MSF-Brasil, garantindo a consistência dos programas oferecidos para as pessoas funcionarias, conscientizando a organização sobre a importância de captação de recursos e relacionamento com as pessoas doadoras;
  • Compartilhar insights e performance da área com outros departamentos da organização continuamente, assegurando trabalho transversal;
  • Participar e contribuir com o fórum de ONGs no Brasile plataformas internacionais, trazendo insumos relevantes do mercado e ideias inovadoras, adaptando para o cenário de MSF-Brasil;
  • Influenciar a cultura organizacional para que práticas de captação e relacionamento sejam compreendidas e realizadas de forma ética, inclusiva e alinhada aos valores institucionais;

Compromissos de gestão de MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, promovendo uma gestão de pessoas ética, equitativa e inclusiva, que valorize a escuta ativa, fomente uma cultura de feedback contínuo e incentive o desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Aplicar e disseminar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização, assegurando um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios da organização;
  • Favorecer a colaboração entre áreas e o trabalho transversal, desenvolvendo e aprimorando processos integrados com olhar estratégico;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o Planejamento Estratégico e Plano Anual, participando de monitoramentos periódicos, identificando riscos e ajustando prioridades com responsabilidade e visão sistêmica;
  • Garantir a implementação e promoção ativa de práticas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI), valorizando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e promovendo um ambiente seguro para todas as pessoas;

Promoção de cultura ágil e contribuição para mudança

  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, incentivando ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Estimular a criatividade e a experimentação, propondo soluções inovadoras e ousadas que ampliem a relevância e o engajamento de MSF-Brasil junto ao público brasileiro;
  • Basear e incentivar decisões em dados e evidências, fortalecendo a transparência, a eficiência e o foco em resultados;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança no processo de transformação do Hub, contribuindo para a implementação de novas formas de trabalhar, incluindo cultura data-driven e metodologia ágil.

  • Sólida experiência em liderança de crescimento e captação de recursos;
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas e canais diversos de marketing;
  • Domínio do inglês (avançado);
  • Conhecimentos de estratégia de marketing e análise de resultados, propostas, tendências;
  • Conhecimentos de metodologia ágil e gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimentos de CRMs, bancos de dados e Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD);

title: Metering Engineer
description:
This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM).
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO.
  • Participate/assist in metering audits.
  • Act as Technical Authority to measurement issues.
  • Verify that FPSO operator’s procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards.
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP.
  • Keep updated the measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system).
  • Validate offloading measurement reports.
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation.
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades.
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions.
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes.
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading / unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers.
  • Follow up the routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems.
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written).

description:
Overview

The Business Development Manager drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Account Management and Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is the core sales position within the company responsible for new business and clients as well as managing and leveraging existing accounts. The Business Development Manager drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts.

What You Will Do

  • Contribute to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).
  • Sell ABS services using the strength of local affiliates’ business structure.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.

  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited university or equivalent business/quality-related experience.
  • 5 or more years of experience in the industry is preferred.
  • Business experience in the manufacturing and/or technical service industry.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Self-motivated professional with a track record of sales leadership.
  • High energy professional with a commitment to succeed in sales and business development.
  • Facile with computers, both in preparing presentations and communications and in working within ABS QE’s operating platforms.
  • Familiarity with management systems is helpful. Otherwise, the ability to learn new areas quickly will be critical.
  • Sensitive to multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communicator both with customers and the sales team.
  • Focus on the result; strong desire to achieve objectives despite challenges.
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Director of Business Development or senior level manager.

description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The positon

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.

  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.

title: Analista Operações Logísticas, AMXL
description:
Job ID: | Amazon Logistica do Brasil

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejan itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logística do Brasil está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time que gerencia as operações de Extra Large (AMXL). Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em escala 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back. Essa pessoa atuará na gestão e execução tática das rotinas nas estações de entrega dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos. Essa pessoa também será a guardiã dos processos e padrões da Amazon específicos para a operação de produtos pesados e grandes (Heavy and Bulky). Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria/visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco para atuar como guardião dos SOPs padrões do node.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Orientar e liderar plano de ação com parceiros em busca da excelência operacional;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.

A day in the life

Seu dia é dedicado a monitorar a Torre de Controle e executar rotinas diárias no node para entregas de produtos Pesados/Grandes (Heavy/Bulky). Você é o guardião dos SOPs da AMXL, realizando consultas no sistema, gerenciando o check-in dos motoristas e abrindo tickets de suporte. Você coordena com a equipe para resolver desafios operacionais para encantar o cliente Amazon. Seu principal contato é o parceiro AMXL, cuja performance você melhora diretamente através de planos de ações consolidados.

Requirements

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 25% do tempo.
  • Inglês básico.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • SQL e outras linguagens de programação.
  • Experiência em Logística, e/ou Transportes de itens volumosos e pesados.

description:
IFRJ abre seleção para professor substituto em Arraial do Cabo

Vagas são para as áreas de Computação, Letras e Educação Física; inscrições seguem até 26 de fevereiro

O Instituto Federal de Educação, Ciência e Tecnologia do Rio de Janeiro (IFRJ) está com edital aberto para a contratação de professores substitutos no Campus Arraial do Cabo. As oportunidades são destinadas às áreas de Computação, Letras e Educação Física, com objetivo de garantir a continuidade das atividades acadêmicas na unidade.

A seleção será feita por meio de processo seletivo simplificado, composto por análise de currículo e entrevista. As inscrições devem ser realizadas entre os dias 2 e 26 de fevereiro, exclusivamente pela internet, no site oficial do IFRJ. A taxa de inscrição é de R$ 80,00.

Os profissionais selecionados irão atuar em regime de 40 horas semanais. A remuneração varia conforme a titulação do candidato, com valores que vão de R$ 4.326,60 a R$ 8.058,29.

Para participar do processo seletivo, é necessário ter formação compatível com a área pretendida, ser brasileiro nato ou naturalizado, estar em dia com as obrigações eleitorais, ter idade mínima de 18 anos e, no caso dos candidatos do sexo masculino, estar regular com o serviço militar.

O edital completo, com todas as informações sobre requisitos, cronograma e critérios de avaliação, está disponível no site do IFRJ, em .

Localizado no bairro da Prainha, em Arraial do Cabo, o Campus do IFRJ atua há 16 anos na Região dos Lagos e é reconhecido pelo ensino público, gratuito e de qualidade. A unidade oferece formação nos eixos de Tecnologia e Meio Ambiente, com cursos que vão do ensino técnico integrado ao ensino médio até a pós-graduação.

Estamos entre as principais companhias independentes com atuação no Onshore do Brasil. Nosso maior diferencial é produzir energia por meio do gás natural, recurso energético mais estável e limpo. Somos movidos pelo propósito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento do país mediante a integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Priorizamos a execução de estratégias e projetos responsáveis para promover um desenvolvimento mais homogêneo das regiões onde atuamos.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos muito felizes por saber que você se interessou em embarcar em uma grande jornada aqui no Grupo EP, e para isso é muito importante que conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

  • Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade, atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
  • Estamos entre as5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país, com50 anos de existência .
  • Visamos o cuidado e respeito ao meio ambiente, com isso tivemos mais de660 milhões de m³ de efluentes tratados por nossos clientes até hoje (o equivalente ao consumo de água da população do estado de SP, 12 milhões de pessoas, durante um ano).
  • Nosso maior objetivo é a expansão da nossa organização, em 2033 nossa meta é expandir nossa atuação no Brasil com isso contamos um time de500 colaboradores divididos nas 5 frentes de atuação da EP.

Temos quatro valores que regem nossos direcionamentos e atuação na EP, que são:

  • Paixão por aprender: Aqui valorizamos, incentivamos e investimos pesado em educação. Somos uma empresa que presta serviço, ou seja, vendemos o conhecimento do nosso time e por isso oferecemos diversas maneiras para que você tenha acesso aos melhores cursos e se desenvolvam profissionalmente.
  • Falo e faço : É o valor que garante um ambiente íntegro e coerente entre o discurso e as ações. Transparência e honestidade são essenciais em qualquer relação dentro e fora da EP, com colaboradores, clientes, fornecedores e comunidade.
  • Visto a camisa : Para termos sucesso no mercado e qualidade em cada serviço que fornecemos, valorizamos que nossos colaboradores estejam alinhados com nosso propósito e que possam exercer suas funções em sua totalidade e com segurança.
  • Hoje melhor que ontem : Acreditamos que se todos buscarem fazer hoje algo melhor do que fizeram ontem, visando melhoria contínua, seremos uma empresa melhor a cada dia também. Para nós qualidade é nosso combustível que nos mantém ativos.

Se você, assim como nós, também é movido à água e quer fazer a diferença no mundo. Vem com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Missão do cargo: As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Atuar na área operacional de estações de tratamentos de água e efluentes (industriais e domésticos) e reuso de água, mantendo em perfeito funcionamento;
  • Realizar monitoramento dos volumes dos tanques;
  • Realizar leitura de temperatura, pH, turbidez, Resíduos Sedimentáveis e Sedimentabilidade do lodo, de acordo com os procedimentos internos;
  • Preparar e repor produtos químicos inerentes ao processo de tratamento;
  • Preencher planilhas de controle – trabalho diário e controle de qualidade;
  • Verificar indicadores de funcionamento;
  • Operar e realizar pequenas manutenções em equipamentos pertinentes à área;
  • Controlar e organizar o estoque de reagentes, vidrarias e equipamentos do laboratório, reportando necessidades de reposição;
  • Realizar coleta de amostras para análise em laboratório;
  • Realizar análises químicas de baixa complexidade;
  • Prezar pela organização e manutenção do ambiente de trabalho;
  • Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Requisitos e qualificações

Pré-requisitos para essa função:

  • Curso Técnico em Química, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;
  • CRQ ativo;
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano com tratamento de água/ efluentes.

title: Senior Accountant, Student Financials Accounting
description:
Principal Accountabilities

Financial Oversight & Revenue Recognition

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Accountant, Student Financials Accounting supports the accurate accounting, reconciliation, and reporting of student‑related financial transactions. This position is responsible for preparing the monthly student financial journal entries, completing complex reconciliations, performing detailed revenue and expense analyses, and ensuring compliance with GAAP and ASC 606. The Senior Accountant collaborates closely with the Manager to support the monthly close process, system improvements, and cross‑departmental initiatives that strengthen student financial operations.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include staff within the Controller’s Office, Bursar, Financial Aid, Registrar, Budget Office, and other departments within the university. External contacts include auditors, consultants, and system support partners.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Perform the accounting and reconciliation of student charges, payments, financial aid disbursements, and related deferrals in accordance with GAAP and ASC 606 revenue recognition standards.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed balance sheet reconciliations for student financial accounts; research variances and escalate issues as needed.
  • Assist with the calculation and documentation of the uncollectible reserves for student accounts.
  • Reconcile student‑related cash accounts and coordinate with the Bursar’s Office to resolve discrepancies in payment, refund, and posting processes.
  • Support the monthly close process by preparing journal entries, accruals, and variance analyses for student revenue and expense accounts.
  • Prepare audit schedules, documentation, and supporting workpapers for both internal and external audits.

Process Improvement & System Enhancements

  • Identify process gaps and recommend enhancements to improve reconciliation accuracy, workflow efficiency, and data integrity.
  • Assist with system updates, testing, and implementation related to student financials within ERP systems (e.g., Workday Student and Workday Finance).
  • Document standard operating procedures and ensure adherence to internal controls and university policies.

Cross‑Departmental Collaboration

  • Partner with the Bursar, Financial Aid, and Registrar’s Office to ensure accurate financial transactions and alignment of data across systems.
  • Participate in cross‑functional meetings and provide accounting insights related to student financial operations.
  • Support the Manager in developing financial analysis, reporting, and presentations for university leadership.

Other Responsibilities

  • Stay current on accounting standards, higher education financial practices, and regulatory updates affecting student accounts.
  • Assist with special projects and perform other job‑related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, revenue recognition principles, and accounting practices within a higher education environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in general ledger accounting, reconciliations, and financial analysis.
  • Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.

Controller’s Office

  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel; experience with enterprise accounting and student systems (e.g., Workday) preferred.
  • High level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field required.
  • Minimum of 4–5 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in higher education or public accounting.
  • Experience with ASC 606 or revenue accounting is strongly preferred.
  • Workday or large ERP system experience strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet strict deadlines.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,000-$115,000

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project ( and drive specialized data scraping workflows within our hybrid AI + human system.

In this role, as a AI Pilot – that's how we refer to this role at Mindrift – you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide critical thinking, domain expertise, and quality control to deliver accurate and actionable results.

This part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands‑on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Vibe Code specialist, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end‑to‑end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage internal tools (Apify, OpenRouter) alongside custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript‑rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross‑source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine‑tuning AI outputs, you'll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real‑world applications.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in data analysis, AI automation, data engineering, or software development is desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Python web scraping: Build reliable scraping scripts using BeautifulSoup, Selenium (or equivalents) for multi‑level sites, dynamic JS content (infinite scroll, AJAX), and API endpoints via provided proxy.
  • Data extraction expertise: Navigate complex hierarchical structures (regions → companies → details), handling archived pages and varied HTML formats.
  • Data processing: Clean, normalize, and validate scraped data; deliver high‑quality datasets in well‑structured formats (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets) with clear, consistent presentation.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem‑solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self‑directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper‑intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands‑on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly – a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance‑based bonus programs that reward high‑quality work and consistent delivery.

  • Utiliza ferramentas como Excel e Power BI como suporte analítico, mas com foco central em processos de RH, governança e planejamento.

What experience would we like you to have?

Conhecimentos Necessários

  • Inglês Fluente ;

  • Experiência com Workforce Planning

  • Graduação superior em Análise de Dados, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins.

title: Online teachers for Geography (IAS level)
description:
Job Summary

Join our global team as an online teacher for IAS Geography and immerse yourself in a premium one‑on‑one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you’ll deliver A‑Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

The hours needed are 7pm on a Thursday or Friday in the Russian Timezone.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalized, high‑quality instruction in a one‑on‑one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.

Required Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of teaching Level/Form 7‑13 experience in a school setting.
  • While valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience toward this requirement.
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching.
  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A‑Levels curricula and examinations.
  • The ability to dedicate at least 15‑20 hours weekly for 6‑9 months once you take a student.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license.
  • Online teaching experience.

About Crimson Global Academy

CGA is a world‑class online school delivering live, real‑time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We are doing this by:

  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting‑edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education.

If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one‑on‑one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning—apply now!

To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories.

Sobre o Grupo Profarma

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país.

Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis, em Santa Catarina (SC). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Responsável por implementar e acompanhar processos de RH nas áreas sob sua Diretoria/Vice-Presidência, incluindo Arquitetura Organizacional, Performance & Sucessão, Comitês de Talentos, Remuneração e Benefícios, Pesquisas de Engajamento, Treinamento e Programas de Desenvolvimento. Atua como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, influenciando e apoiando a gestão para fortalecer ambientes seguros e alinhados aos valores e competências da organização.

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das lideranças, apoiando no desenvolvimento da gestão e engajamento das equipes;
  • Influenciar e facilitar o desenvolvimento de executivos e gestores, acompanhando planos individuais e evolução de competências;

  • Planejar e implementar ações de capacitação, desenvolvimento de lideranças e gestão de talentos (comitês, sucessão, carreira);
  • Apoiar na gestão do clima organizacional, pesquisas de engajamento e planos de ação para melhoria contínua;
  • Elaborar relatórios e books gerenciais com dados estratégicos para suporte à tomada de decisão das lideranças;

Qualificações

Graduação em Psicologia,AdministraçãoouEngenharias;

Pósgraduaçãoem áreascorrelatas ;

Sólida experiênciaem RH e seus subsistemas;

Português Brasileiroe Inglês fluentes;

Experiência no setor de energia elétricae comercializadoras.

Informações Adicionais

Conosco, você desenvolverá uma trajetória profissional com oportunidades incríveis. Isso inclui:

  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional em vários níveis da organização, incluindo LinkedIn Learning, programas e ações de desenvolvimento;
  • A chance de fazer parte de uma organização verdadeiramente global, composta por profissionais competentes, inovadores e responsáveis, de diferentes países e culturas;
  • Uma cultura organizacional que cuida e respeita as pessoas, oferecendo soluções de trabalho flexíveis, princípios de equilíbrio entre vida profissional.
  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Previdência privada, com contrapartida por parte da empresa.
  • Vale alimentação/refeição.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos até 7 anos.
  • Auxílio para pais e mães com filhos com deficiência.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, respectivamente 6 meses e 20 dias.
  • PAS – Programa de Apoio Statkraft, serviço profissional com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros.

O que é fazer parte da Statkraft?

É contribuir para um planeta mais verde e sustentável. Ser Statkraft é renovar a energia que impulsiona o mundo: uma energia limpa, inspiradora, com ética, integridade e segurança.

Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar pessoas a escrever a nossa história, com acolhimento e respeito à diversidade em toda a sua plenitude.

Ser parte da Statkraft é vivenciar os nossos valores, é ser competente, responsável e inovador. É ter uma comunicação aberta e transparente.

Compromisso com a diversidade

A visão da Statkraft é renovar a forma como o mundo é movido. Para navegar essa jornada complexa, precisamos de todas as vozes à mesa. Por isso, trabalhamos ativamente para ser um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, e damos boas-vindas a todos os candidatos, independentemente de origem, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa, etnia, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

  • Advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, vlookups, data visualization)

  • Experience with tag management through GTM, Segment or other platforms

Strategic & Executional Abilities

  • Proven ability to execute A/B tests and iterate on learnings
  • Strong grasp of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and landing page best practices
  • Ability to adapt strategies based on competitive trends and seasonality

Other Qualifications

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, remote‑first environment
  • Passion for SEM and digital marketing, with a test‑and‑learn mindset
  • Willing to accept challenges and be a pro‑active problem solver

Benefits

  • Salary range: 50k to 70k USD annually

Introdução

Bem-vindo à Gallagher – uma comunidade global de pessoas que trazem ideias ousadas, profunda expertise e um compromisso compartilhado com o que é certo. Ajudamos nossos clientes a enfrentar a complexidade com confiança, capacitando empresas, comunidades e indivíduos a prosperar.   • Supporting employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, and performance management.
  • Leading initiatives that promote employee wellbeing, such as health and wellness programs, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to leadership on HR-related matters, providing guidance on policies, procedures, and employee relations.

Sobre você

  • Experience in hard HR areas such as workforce planning, compensation, benefits, compliance, and HR data management.
  • Strong knowledge of local labor laws and regulations.
  • Experience in implementing wellbeing and development programs that enhance employee engagement and growth.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with leaders and employees.
  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

title: Grants Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Project Director provides day-to-day operational and strategic implementation leadership for the ASCEND-AI initiative, a multi-year, multi-institution collaboration between Howard University and Bowie State University focused on advancing AI literacy, responsible AI use, faculty development, curriculum infusion, and student application pathways. This role is responsible for translating the project vision and grant goals into coordinated action through faculty learning communities, collaborative workshops, curriculum module infusion, and student-facing activities. The Project Director ensures that activities are well planned, executed on schedule, and aligned with the approved workplan and budget, while supporting continuous improvement in partnership with project leadership and evaluators. The Project Director does not conduct evaluation but plays a critical role in enabling responsive implementation informed by evaluation findings.

Supervisory Accountability

None

Nature And Scope

The Project Director is essential to ensuring ASCEND-AI’s ambitious goals translate into real, coordinated outcomes. By connecting planning to execution through faculty learning communities, curriculum infusion, workshops, and student application pathways, this role enables the project to move beyond theory into sustained impact across institutions.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Strategic Planning and Program Execution
  • Lead operational planning to ensure ASCEND-AI goals are achieved through:
    • Faculty Learning Community (FLC) sessions
    • Curriculum module infusion across disciplines
    • Three annual collaborative workshops
    • AI Use Competitions and student application activities
  • Translate high-level project goals into clear timelines, milestones, and execution plans.
  • Coordinate with PI and Co-PIs to ensure consistency between vision, planning, and implementation.
  • Ensure activities across Howard University and Bowie State University align in scope, pacing, and intent.

Faculty Learning Communities and Curriculum Infusion

  • Coordinate logistics, scheduling, and documentation for Faculty Learning Communities.
  • Support FLC facilitators in aligning sessions with project goals related to AI literacy, responsible AI use, and discipline-specific integration.
  • Track progress of curriculum module infusion across participating courses.
  • Ensure faculty development activities remain practical, accessible, and aligned with instructional realities.
  • Support knowledge sharing across institutions while allowing for contextual adaptation.
  • Ensure Faculty Learning Communities and curriculum infusion efforts are structured to support faculty success while minimizing additional administrative or instructional burden.

Workshops, Competitions, and Student Application Pathways

  • Plan and coordinate three annual collaborative workshops, including agendas, speakers, materials, and logistics.
  • Support implementation of AI Use Competitions and other applied learning experiences.
  • Ensure workshops and competitions reinforce project pillars such as human-in-the-loop AI use, ethical reasoning, and applied innovation.
  • Coordinate with partners and facilitators to maintain high-quality, well-run events.

Budget Monitoring and Financial Reporting

  • Monitor project expenditures monthly in coordination with the PI and institutional grants offices.
  • Prepare monthly budget summaries for PI review.
  • Generate quarterly financial reports for:
    • Howard University Grants Office
    • Bowie State University Grants Office
    • ASCEND-AI Advisory Board
  • Track alignment of spending with approved budget categories, including faculty stipends, staffing, curriculum development, workshops, evaluation services, and partnerships.
  • Identify potential budget or resource concerns early and support resolution.

Continuous Improvement and Coordination with Evaluation

  • Participate in quarterly data review meetings with:
    • PI and Co-PIs
    • Project Coordinator
    • FLC facilitators
    • Brick Rose Exchange evaluator
  • Support implementation adjustments based on formative evaluation findings while preserving evaluator independence.
  • Coordinate follow-up actions resulting from data-informed discussions.
  • Ensure documentation and implementation records support learning and accountability.

Cross-Institutional and Administrative Coordination

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison between Howard University and Bowie State University.
  • Coordinate closely with the Project Coordinator at Bowie State University to manage inter-institutional timelines and logistics.
  • Maintain shared calendars, agendas, documentation, and communication channels.
  • Support dissemination activities and preparation of project documentation as needed.

Core Competencies

  • A self-starter who works well independently
  • Highly organized and proactive
  • Aligned with the vision and intent of ASCEND-AI
  • Reliable with strong follow-through
  • Tech-savvy and adaptable
  • Comfortable navigating complexity and ambiguity
  • Skilled at keeping people, plans, and timelines moving forward

Minimum Requirements

Demonstrated experience managing complex, grant-funded projects, preferably in higher education, technology, workforce development, or innovation-focused initiatives. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously. Experience coordinating faculty, administrators, and external partners. Comfort working independently, taking initiative, and following through on tasks with minimal supervision. Strong communication and coordination skills.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$75,000-$85,000

Sobre a AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN). A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reporting Structure

Reports to:

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO and Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project

Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons

Liaises with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

About Us

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: Sr Business Development Manager, Flights LATAM
description:
About the job

As a Business Development Manager, Airline Partnerships, you will support and grow relationships with a portfolio of airline distribution partners, helping to drive revenue growth and long-term collaboration.

You will represent the company in day‑to‑day airline partner interactions, working closely with internal teams to execute commercial initiatives, support partner needs, and contribute to enterprise growth goals. This role requires a mix of account management, sales execution, and analytical skills.

At Hopper, you can have an immediate impact in a high‑growth environment. Airline sales and distribution is a specialized field, so prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, airline, etc.) is a strong plus, particularly within the LATAM market.

Successful candidates will be able to clearly communicate Hopper’s value proposition and effectively position our products and capabilities to airline partners.

What your day‑to‑day would look like:

  • Support the management of a portfolio of airline accounts, contributing to growth strategies and execution plans
  • Track partner performance, analyze results, and help identify risks and growth opportunities
  • Build a strong understanding of partner business objectives and assist in developing initiatives aligned with their strategy
  • Identify opportunities to improve commercial relationships and collaborate with internal teams to address them
  • Help organize and participate in quarterly business reviews with airline partners
  • Partner with finance teams to support forecasting and revenue tracking for airline partnerships
  • Assist in developing and executing marketing initiatives and insertion orders (I/Os) with airline partners in support of growth goals
  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments in collaboration with senior team members
  • Act as a liaison between airline partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution and a strong traveler experience
  • Develop a working knowledge of the global travel market, with a focus on airline industry dynamics.

An ideal candidate has

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management with a track record of supporting revenue growth
  • Prior experience in airline distribution (OTA, TMC, GDS, or airline), with exposure to or experience in the LATAM market preferred
  • Familiarity with commercial, cultural, and regulatory dynamics of the LATAM travel ecosystem
  • A positive, proactive, and self‑motivated attitude
  • Ability to prepare and deliver clear, data‑driven presentations
  • A collaborative, team‑first mindset
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills
  • A detail‑oriented and analytical approach to problem‑solving
  • Passion for travel, technology, and digital commerce
  • Foundational value‑selling skills and commercial acumen
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced, evolving environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English & Portuguese

Perks and benefits of working with us:

  • Well‑funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre‑IPO equity packages.
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend.
  • Hopper will cover 100% of the employee premiums for EOR‑offered health, dental, life and short term disability insurances with SulAmerica.
  • Hopper offers employees in Brazil monthly meal vouchers
  • Very generous parental leave
  • Flexdesk All Access Pass & Work‑from‑home stipend.
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.
  • Open communication with management and company leadership.
  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.

More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world‑class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end‑to‑end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:

Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.

Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no‑questions‑asked resolutions.

Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co‑develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen‑Z and millennials travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials..

Come take off with us!

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.
